recorded.outcome:q-mixed-traffic: The output row 'web (fixed) and mobile  20 of 20 runs oversold' plus 'the fixed web copy doesn't protect them. The mobile copy reads 2, a web order moves the counter to 3, and the mobile copy adds a fourth' decide c.
recorded.prompt:q-which-test: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-which-test: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-which-test: 'only a test that runs several threads through the unfixed copy finds the race' together with the mobile row (20 of 20 oversold) and the mixed row decides a.
recorded.prompt:q-callers-unchanged: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-callers-unchanged: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-callers-unchanged: The heading 'A Fix Made in the Owning Class Reaches Every Caller Without Touching Them', every row going to 0 after 'the one edit to tryRedeem', and 'javac produced the same bytes for WebCheckout.class and MobileCheckout.class before and after the fix' decide a.
recorded.prompt:q-accessor: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-accessor: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-accessor: 'The public counter() of the first design is what made the copies possible: any class holding the AtomicInteger could write its own check-then-update' together with 'A method int redeemed(String code) ... is safe to add' decides b.

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-mixed-traffic:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-mixed-traffic:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-mixed-traffic:a: Refuted by the mixed row being oversold in 20 of 20 runs and 'the fixed web copy doesn't protect them'.
recorded.prompt:q-mixed-traffic:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-mixed-traffic:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-mixed-traffic:b: Refuted by the same mixed row and the read-2/web-to-3/mobile-adds-fourth interleaving, which shows the fixed copy does not order the other copy's separate read and write.
recorded.prompt:q-mixed-traffic:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-mixed-traffic:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-mixed-traffic:d: Refuted by 'getAndUpdate ... stores the function's result only if no other thread changed the count in between, and retries otherwise' and the fixed-only row at 0 of 20; its 'Oversell' half is true, only the reason is wrong.
recorded.prompt:q-which-test:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-which-test:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-which-test:b: Refuted by 'web, after its fix  0 of 20 runs oversold' and 'The first two rows are the team's load test, which the fix passed' while production still oversold.
recorded.prompt:q-which-test:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-which-test:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-which-test:c: Refuted by 'On one thread nothing can come between the mobile copy's check and its update, so it refuses the fourth redemption too'.
recorded.prompt:q-which-test:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-which-test:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-which-test:d: Refuted because both copies on the page read the same codes.limit() and the single-thread sentence shows the unfixed copy refuses at the limit, so a single-threaded test finds no difference; the 'disagree on the limit' claim is refuted only by the code, not by an explicit sentence.
recorded.prompt:q-callers-unchanged:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-callers-unchanged:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-callers-unchanged:b: Refuted because the fix was 'the one edit to tryRedeem' (the getAndUpdate sequence), while the mobile copy's two calls on the same AtomicInteger counters still raced (mobile row 20 of 20); its 'Nothing in either' half is true, only the reason is wrong.
recorded.prompt:q-callers-unchanged:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-callers-unchanged:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-callers-unchanged:c: Refuted on the 'must change' claim: callers were not touched and still went to 0 oversold with identical bytes; the page never discusses caller-side locks, so the says' 'excludes only that caller's threads' reasoning is not on the page.
recorded.prompt:q-callers-unchanged:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-callers-unchanged:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-callers-unchanged:d: Refuted by 'a caller may check it, but the only way to change the count is tryRedeem, which checks again' and by callers going to zero without any added check.
recorded.prompt:q-accessor:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-accessor:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-accessor:a: Refuted by 'int redeemed(String code) ... is safe to add: a caller may check it, but the only way to change the count is tryRedeem, which checks again'.
recorded.prompt:q-accessor:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-accessor:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-accessor:c: Refuted by the same sentence declaring the int accessor safe, which leaves only the AtomicInteger accessor as the risk.
recorded.prompt:q-accessor:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-accessor:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-accessor:d: Refuted by 'any class holding the AtomicInteger could write its own check-then-update, and nothing but review would stop it' and the SupportDesk paste that relied on counter().
